# Taranga Electro Centre

> Taranga Electro Centre (তরঙ্গ, "Taranga") is one of the oldest music labels in Bangladesh, started by Subrata Kumar Deb in the cassette and CD era, before 2000. It holds one of the largest Bangla folk-music catalogues in the country — Baul, Bhatiali, Bhawaiya, Lalon and regional traditions — plus modern, film and devotional songs, drama and entertainment video. Since 2016 the catalogue lives on YouTube and streaming platforms. Taranga is an ANS Music company; everything operates under the Taranga name.

Website: https://tarangaec.com
Tagline: Live the magic of music with TARANGA.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1990s (before 2000), by Subrata Kumar Deb, in the cassette/CD era
- Online since: after 2016
- Ownership: ANS Music (https://ansmusic.io); brand and channels remain Taranga
- YouTube (six channels, totals checked September 2026): 7.8M+ subscribers, 2.6B+ views, 3,600+ videos
- Genres: Folk, Baul, Bhatiali, Bhawaiya, Lalon, Modern, Film, Devotional, Drama
- Notable artists on the label's channels: Sharif Uddin, Emon Khan

## YouTube channels
- Taranga Electro Centre (main, folk catalogue): https://www.youtube.com/@TarangaElectroCentre
- Taranga Music Centre (TMC, new music releases): https://www.youtube.com/@tarangamusiccenter
- Taranga Music: https://www.youtube.com/@TarangaMusic
- Taranga Entertainment: https://www.youtube.com/@TarangaEntertainment
- Bangla Entertainment: https://www.youtube.com/@BanglaEntertainmentNow
- Bangla Drama: https://www.youtube.com/@bangladrama3400

## Contact
- A&R (singers, music directors, lyricists): ar@tarangaec.com
- Publishing, TV, cable and commercial sync: contact@tarangaec.com
- Legal: legal@ansmusic.io

## How to submit music
Email ar@tarangaec.com with links to 1–3 songs (private YouTube, Drive or SoundCloud), your name, whether the songs are already released, and how to reach you. Every submission is listened to.
